description: Search for an Okta group by its name and return its ID.
command:
"$OKTA_URL/api/v1/groups?q=${answer1}" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; text=sys.stdin.read(); exec("try:
 data=json.loads(text)
 print(json.dumps({"id": data[0]["id"]} if isinstance(data, list) and data else {"error": "Not found"}))
except: print(json.dumps({"error": "Invalid response"}))")'
questions: What is the name of the Okta group to search for?*
